scientific_integrity: A full all-orders proof is provided; finite exact-arithmetic tests are corroboration, not exhaustive proof. No independent validation or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite simple unweighted graphs, ordinary combinatorial Laplacian Hamiltonians and infinite-time Cesàro averaging. No assertion for weighted joins, adjacency walks or other observation measures. A stronger unlocated structural theorem could cover this deduction.
title: Laplacian quantum average-mixing rank under arbitrary graph joins
